verdict.rationale: Gusto's core payroll platform shows no open-source availability. The only openly licensed first-party code in evidence is the public gusto-cli repository on GitHub under Apache-2.0, which is a client-side developer and agent interface rather than the product itself. Missing for 10: open-licensed source for the core payroll/HR service, license details for the React SDK and API client libraries, any statement of open-source policy.
